newsitem.title: USA: Alfin sees Q4 gain of $900,000 from sale.
newsitem.headline: Alfin sees Q4 gain of $900,000 from sale.

text.p: Alfin Inc said Friday that it will record a gain of $904,160 in its fiscal fourth quarter, which ends July 31 due to the sale of its New Jersey distribution, warehousing and administration facility.

The company said in a statement that it sold the facility on June 13 for $1.4 million. The company said it used $450,000 to pay back the remaining balance due on its promisory note to PNC Bank and $84,840 to cover selling expenses.

The company, which is the maker and distributor of Adrien Arpel cosmetics, said it consolidated its administrative staff offices and customer service center into the New York headquarters. Alfin said it expects to save $800,000 annually because of this move.

In addition to these financial and physical plant moves, Alfin, which is a completely owned subsidiary of Alfin Fragrances, said it has entered the mail order business, installing toll free lines to service its customers. Customers seeking their products may call 1-888-202-2222.
